# PravasiDhan

> Your trusted guide to NRI finance — taxes, remittances, investments, property, and banking for Indians abroad.

PravasiDhan provides educational guides for Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) in Canada, the USA, and the UK on cross-border financial topics including tax filing, money transfers to India, NRE/NRO bank accounts, and investment options. Content is research-backed and updated regularly.

## Guides

- [Best NRI Tax Filing Services 2026](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/best-nri-tax-filing-services-2026/): ClearTax vs Tax2Win vs hiring a CA — detailed comparison
- [Send Money Canada to India](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/send-money-canada-to-india/): Remittance services compared by fees, exchange rates, and speed
- [Send Money USA to India](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/send-money-usa-to-india/): Best remittance options for US-based NRIs
- [Send Money UK to India](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/send-money-uk-to-india/): Cheapest ways to transfer GBP to INR
- [NRE vs NRO Account — Canada](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/nre-vs-nro-account-canada-nri/): Which bank account type Canadian NRIs need
- [NRE vs NRO Account — USA](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/nre-vs-nro-account-usa-nri/): NRE vs NRO for US-based Indians
- [NRE vs NRO Account — UK](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/nre-vs-nro-account-uk-nri/): NRE vs NRO for UK-based Indians
- [NRI ITR Filing Deadline 2026 — Canada](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/nri-itr-filing-deadline-2026-canada/): Key dates and filing requirements
- [NRI ITR Filing Deadline 2026 — USA](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/nri-itr-filing-deadline-2026-usa/): US NRI tax deadlines and extensions
- [NRI ITR Filing Deadline 2026 — UK](https://pravasidhan.com/guides/nri-itr-filing-deadline-2026-uk/): UK NRI tax filing calendar
